description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ThingUnavailableException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a specific 'Thing' resource is temporarily unavailable. It includes various constructors, builder pattern implementation, and is annotated for immutability and JSON parsing.

classes.name: ThingUnavailableException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException indicating the 'Thing' resource is unavailable, with static builder methods and JSON parsing capabilities.

classes.name: ThingUnavailableException.Builder
classes.description: Inner static builder class facilitating creation of immutable ThingUnavailableException instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.
